mapper.select: SELECT u.sys_user_id AS friendID, u.user_nickname AS friendName, COALESCE(bf.nickname, u.user_nickname) AS nickname, u.user_avatar AS avatar, u.is_deleted AS isDeleted, bf.category_id AS categoryID FROM biz_friend bf INNER JOIN biz_user u ON bf.sys_friend_id = u.sys_user_id WHERE bf.creator_id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0
